'''Klorma Draill''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Draill was a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] starlet and she also became the mistress of [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Zerex]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Adinorr]]. When Zerex secured a promotion to become the [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]], Draill attended a celebratory party that he held in his mansion, on Ord Adinorr.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
